title: LCLI-807 follow-ups: referenceKey in orphans, link dedupe and projection edges, fold-table test and generator nits
description:
Follow-up carried from the #749/#750 Opus verdict (recorded on LCLI-807). Done inside lore's slack before LBUMP, with a Sonnet review; does not gate LBUMP unless ready.
- #749 SF1: src/core/orphans.ts around :262, :276, :286-288 classifies by referenceKey over id plus aliases, and both new orphans tests assert orphanTasks: [] (red today).
- #749 SF2: link.ts containsCaseInsensitive (~:1095) and dedupeTaskIds (~:1069), and projection.ts ~:206-213 edges, all by referenceKey.
- #750 SF2: rename the tautological 'agrees with the library at EVERY code point' test as self-consistency and drop the drift-protection claim.
- Generator nit 2: --lib checked against a pinned sha256, and --ts comparing the whole module.
- The comment nits, plus one CHANGELOG line for the fold change.
- Until quest has its pin, reword the three 'fails in whichever half lags' comments to say only lore's half is pinned.
#750 SF1 (quest's missing case-fold digest pin) is a pair item routed to quest-cli, not here.

acceptanceCriteria.text: orphans, link dedupe/contains and projection edges classify by referenceKey, each with a test red without the fix
The tautological every-code-point test is renamed as self-consistency and no longer claims drift protection
The generator checks --lib against a pinned sha256 and --ts compares the whole module
The three whichever-half-lags comments say only lore half is pinned; one CHANGELOG line covers the fold change
